subject: Teachers Union Vote of No Confidence
overview: Medford teachers rallied at City Hall to deliver a vote of no confidence to the Mayor and School Committee following an 18-month contract stalemate. The union is seeking increased compensation and improved benefits to attract and retain staff.

items.title: Rally at City Hall
items.summary: Over 100 teachers marched to City Hall to deliver a formal vote of no confidence to the Mayor and School Committee.

items.title: Contract Negotiations
items.summary: The union is seeking a 3% pay increase and improved benefits, while the city maintains that a signed tentative agreement has already been reached with union leadership.
